headline: Indonesian Regional Offices Remove Official Photos Of Gibran Raka
seoTitle: Official Photos Of Gibran Raka Removed In Indonesia
metaDescription: Government offices across Indonesia are removing official portraits of Gibran Rakabuming Raka following his resignation as Vice President.
aiSummaryBullets: Government offices in Jakarta and North Sumatra have begun removing official portraits of Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
The removal process follows the vacancy of the Vice Presidential position after Gibran Rakabuming Raka officially resigned.
Regional leaders, including Governor Bobby Nasution, instructed the removal of the photos after consulting with central government authorities.
aiContextParagraph: Following the resignation of Gibran Rakabuming Raka from his position as Vice President of Indonesia, government institutions and public offices across the country have initiated the removal of his official portraits. Regional governments, including the Jakarta Provincial Government and the North Sumatra administration, have confirmed that the action aligns with the current vacancy of the Vice Presidency. Governor Bobby Nasution stated he issued instructions for these removals to ensure local government compliance. Officials in Jakarta confirmed they consulted with the central government regarding the protocol for removing the portraits from public spaces, such as classrooms and transit stations. Similar removal actions have been observed within the national police force's environments. The shift marks a transition in the display of state symbols in government buildings while the national leadership status remains vacant following his recent departure from office.
whyItIsViral: The story has achieved a high viral activity score driven by rapid, consistent reporting from four major Indonesian news outlets documenting the immediate removal of state symbols.
